notes:
What's new in 0.1.21:
• Away-from-home access per person - give each household member their own sign-in for watching outside the house.
• One family pass option for simple shared access.
• Show-password checkboxes on sign-in screens.
• Sign-in attempt limits to block password guessing.
• New app icon - the Beebo rabbit, with a proper transparent background on the desktop.
• Stability and security fixes across the desktop app.
